spans.s:
mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
1 Moveable, locomotive.
2 Surprising, wonderful.
m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A hint or sign, an indication of sentiment by gesture, &c.
2 Knowledge.
E.
इगि to go, affix क.

n. (-तं)
1 Hint, sign, gesture.
2 Going, motion.
3 Intention, purpose.
E.
इगि to go, affix क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Understanding signs.
E.
इङ्गित and ज्ञ who knows.

mf. (-दः-दी)
The name of a plant, commonly Iṅguä.
E.
इङ्गु going, and द what gives; the pen. अ is changed to उ. and the fem. affix is ङीष्.

mf. (-लः-ली)
See the preceding.
E.
as before, द being changed to ल.
